args.body: Hi Lena, during a catalog check today, I noticed that 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 through P-1222) were inadvertently included in the 3% price increase on 2026-10-14. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the increased prices with a total overcharge of $4,128.60. Flagging this for immediate review so we can correct the catalog prices and issue credits/refunds.
